\[
V=W_1\cup\cdots\cup W_n

\[

Indeed, two distinct points in that intersection would have difference $(a-b)u_i\in W_j$ for some $a\ne b$, and therefore $u_i\in W_j$, contradicting the defining property of $u_i$.

\end{proof}
